title: Strings & bytes
description: NUL-terminated C strings vs explicit length
theory:
## Two representations

- **Counted:** keep length in a register (syscall `write`).
- **NUL-terminated:** end with `db '...', 0` when interoperating with libc (`printf`).

This chapter stays syscall-first.

exercises.title: Quoted word
exercises.description: Print exactly `go` (two letters, no newline) from a `.data` label, then exit 0.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
    w: db 'g','o'
    wlen equ $ - w
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    w: db 'g', 'o'
    wlen equ $ - w
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel w]
    mov rdx, wlen
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

exercises.title: Two writes
exercises.description: Print `ab` by issuing **two** `write` syscalls (first prints `a`, second prints `b`), no newline, then exit 0.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
    a: db 'a'
    b: db 'b'
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    a: db 'a'
    b: db 'b'
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel a]
    mov rdx, 1
    syscall
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel b]
    mov rdx, 1
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

exercises.title: NUL-terminated but not printed
exercises.description: Define `db 'Z',0` in `.data`. Print only the `Z` (length **1**, not including the NUL), then exit 0.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
    z: db 'Z', 0
section .text
_start:
    ; write 1 byte from address z
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
hints: The NUL exists for interoperability; `rdx` must still be `1` here
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    z: db 'Z', 0
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel z]
    mov rdx, 1
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

exercises.title: Counted string length
exercises.description: Define `db 'h','i',0` in `.data`. Use **`len equ $ - msg - 1`** style: put the bytes under label `msg` including the trailing `0`, then compute the length **excluding** the NUL (`$ - msg - 1`). Print exactly `hi` with one `write`, then exit 0.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
    msg: db 'h','i',0
    ; len equ $ - msg - 1
section .text
_start:
    ; write stdout, rsi=msg, rdx=len
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
hints: `len equ $ - msg - 1` subtracts the terminating `0` byte
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    msg: db 'h', 'i', 0
    len equ $ - msg - 1
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel msg]
    mov rdx, len
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
